profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Wells Fargo | CS Grad @ USF
profile.summary:
I am a passionate individual with a deep-rooted enthusiasm for computer science and technology. Currently pursuing a Bachelor of Science in Computer Science at the University of South Florida (USF) with a strong academic record, I maintain a GPA of 3.8/4.0.

In my journey as a software developer intern at The Boeing Company, I had the opportunity to contribute significantly to production efficiency. I developed an anomaly detection alert system using Machine Learning algorithms in Splunk, resulting in an 11% increase in error identification. Additionally, I collaborated with colleagues to create a Natural Language Processing app using Python, scikit-learn, and word tokenization, enhancing search filtration for the maintenance portal.

As an Undergraduate Research Assistant at USF's ICNS Lab, I actively engaged in cutting-edge research. I summarized research papers, developed aggregator and host codes, and utilized Python and IBM FL framework to streamline the process of maintaining logs and parallel training. My thirst for knowledge led me to explore recent publications in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning.

In my role as an Information Technology Assistant at USF's Information Technology department, I demonstrated my problem-solving skills by resolving IT issues for users and providing Tier 1 support to field technicians. I also contributed to an Agile team environment, utilizing tools like Jira and Confluence for effective project management.

My project portfolio showcases my technical prowess. I have implemented Natural Language Processing algorithms with NLTK, achieved impressive accuracy rates in credit card fraud detection, and developed a Reddit Bot using Python. I have also collaborated on projects such as Boomerr, a website that recommends computers based on users' needs.

I have served as Vice President of the Association for Computing Machinery (ACM) at USF, organizing workshops and conferences, and as Treasurer, managing finances and collaborating with student government for the benefit of our 300+ members.

My skills encompass a wide array of programming languages and technologies, including Python, C++, C, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and more. I am well-versed in numerous tools and frameworks, such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, Git, and Jira, which have contributed to my success in various roles.

Overall, I am a dedicated and versatile individual, committed to making a positive impact in the field of computer science and technology. I am excited to continue my journey and explore new opportunities for growth and innovation.

positions.locationName: Charlotte, North Carolina, United States · Hybrid

positions.title: Machine Learning Engineer Intern
positions.locationName: St Petersburg, Florida, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
• Developed and integrated an AI model using FinBERT (by ProsusAI) to evaluate commodity performance and identify influencing factors. Performed data preprocessing, feature engineering, and fine-tuning in Python to train the model, improving prediction accuracy for agricultural platforms.

• Created a web scraper in JavaScript to capture market-related tweets, then applied sentiment analysis and correlation modeling to study their impact on commodity price movements.

• Designed and refined a machine learning algorithm that leveraged USDA agricultural datasets to generate commodity performance recommendations. The bot applied quantitative analysis and predictive modeling to support hedging and risk management strategies.

• Built ETL pipelines to extract and transform USDA and commodity market data into structured training datasets. These pipelines powered models analyzing price spreads, cutout values, cash highs/lows, and multi-commodity relationships, enabling more robust and scalable ML experimentation.

positions.title: Undergraduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
• Teaching Assistant for Software System Development (COP 4365)
• Appointed as a TA for COP 4365, focusing on Software System Development using C#, .NET, API, Technical Analysis. 
• Graded projects for 60+ students, offering detailed feedback to enhance student learning & performance.
• Assisted 25+ students by holding regular office hours, providing personalized guidance, and clarifying complex concepts.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.locationName: Charlotte, North Carolina, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
• Spearheaded the development of a robust ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) tool utilizing Python and Apache Airflow, streamlining the data integration process within the SDLC (Software Development Life Cycle). Automated the extraction, transformation, and loading of data from various sources, including REST APIs, SQL, and Oracle databases. This implementation resulted in a 6% boost in overall productivity, while simultaneously reducing data processing time by 9%, enhancing operational efficiency.

• Fine-tuned the PaLM (Pathways Language Model) Large Language Model, meticulously optimizing it for specialized use cases. Improved model accuracy by 14%, and reduced response times by 18%, driving significant advancements in NLP (Natural Language Processing) applications. Leveraged Apache Kafka and PostgreSQL to establish seamless and scalable data pipelines, supporting real-time data processing and enabling the integration of complex NLP solutions with various data-driven applications.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Infrastructure · Software Industry · Python (Programming Language) · Fine Tuning · Large Language Models (LLM) · Large Language Model Operations (LLMOps) · PostgreSQL · Oracle Database
